title: Medicare Advantage vs Original Medicare: The Plain Truth
bigPicture: You have two main choices for your Medicare coverage, and each works a little differently.
whatYouNeedToKnow: Original Medicare is the basic plan run by the government.
Medicare Advantage is a private plan that combines your hospital and doctor coverage and may include extra benefits.
Original Medicare lets you see any doctor that accepts Medicare, while Medicare Advantage usually requires you to stay in their network.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Thinking you must choose one plan and can never change.
Forgetting to check if your doctors are in the Medicare Advantage network.
actionSteps: Review your health needs and see which plan covers them.
Talk to a trusted friend, family member, or counselor about the options.
